parameters.content:
## Missed Call Text-Back (v3)

**Setup (10 min)**
1. Make a copy of the starter Google Sheet (link in your PDF).
2. Open **Config** and paste your Sheet ID + business details.
3. Connect credentials: Twilio, Google Sheets.
4. Click *Test workflow*, then **Activate**.

Built by Clearline Sheets

**Connect Twilio (pick one)**
- Calls ring only on your Twilio number: Phone Numbers > your number > Voice > **Call status changes** = the **Twilio call status** webhook URL (POST).
- Calls forward to your cell with `<Dial>`: put the webhook URL in the Dial **action** (POST), e.g. `<Response><Dial timeout="18" action="WEBHOOK_URL"><Number>+1YOURCELL</Number></Dial></Response>`. Keep `timeout` shorter than your cell's voicemail delay; if voicemail still answers, add `machineDetection="Enable"` and it counts as missed. The webhook answers with an empty TwiML `<Response/>`, so Twilio ends the call cleanly.

Set your timezone, open days/hours and quiet hours in **Config** (open hours always win over quiet hours). Repeat calls within `dedupeMinutes` get no second text. Blocked/anonymous numbers can't receive texts: they are logged with a call-back note.

Emergency trade? Put your on-call number in `emergencyLine`: after-hours texts then include it (also at night).

Optional add-on (not included, ~$0.008/call): Twilio Lookup Line Type to skip landline callers, whose texts never arrive.

v3 (2026-11-24): tested against 15 real-world call cases; fixed forwarded-call status, voicemail answer, blocked caller ID, open vs quiet hours; optional emergency line.

// EDIT THESE VALUES ONCE, then activate the workflow
return [{ json: {
  "sheetId": "PASTE_SHEET_ID",
  "business": "Your Business",
  "twilioNumber": "YOUR_TWILIO_NUMBER",
  "timezone": "America/New_York",
  "openDays": "Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri,Sat",
  "openHour": 7,
  "closeHour": 18,
  "quietStart": 21,
  "quietEnd": 8,
  "dedupeMinutes": 30,
  "emergencyLine": "",
  "text": "Hi, this is {business}. Sorry we missed your call! How can we help? Reply here and we'll get right back to you.",
  "afterHoursText": "Hi, this is {business}. Thanks for calling! We're closed right now, but we'll call you back first thing when we open. Reply here with what you need and we'll be ready.",
  "emergencyText": "Emergency? Call our on-call line now: {emergencyLine}"
} }];

const d = $('Decide').first().json;
return [{ json: { 'Time': new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0,16).replace('T',' '), 'Caller': d.caller, 'Status': d.status, 'Text sent': d.send ? 'Yes' : 'No', 'Notes': d.note } }];
